WITH u AS (
  UPDATE users SET last_login_at = NOW()
  WHERE email = lower(trim($1))
    AND password_hash IS NOT NULL
    AND password_hash = crypt($2, password_hash)
  RETURNING id, email, name, auth_provider
),
t AS (SELECT encode(gen_random_bytes(32), 'hex') AS token),
s AS (
  INSERT INTO sessions (user_id, token_hash)
  SELECT u.id, encode(digest(t.token, 'sha256'), 'hex') FROM u CROSS JOIN t
  RETURNING expires_at
)
SELECT u.id::text AS id, u.email, u.name, u.auth_provider, t.token,
       to_char(s.expires_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS expires_at
FROM u CROSS JOIN t CROSS JOIN s;

-- Conturile cu parolă se creează doar aici; Google trece prin /auth/google.
WITH u AS (
  INSERT INTO users (email, name, password_hash, auth_provider)
  VALUES ($1, $2, crypt($3, gen_salt('bf')), 'email')
  ON CONFLICT (email) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id, email, name, auth_provider
),
t AS (SELECT encode(gen_random_bytes(32), 'hex') AS token),
s AS (
  INSERT INTO sessions (user_id, token_hash)
  SELECT u.id, encode(digest(t.token, 'sha256'), 'hex') FROM u CROSS JOIN t
  RETURNING expires_at
)
SELECT u.id::text AS id, u.email, u.name, u.auth_provider, t.token,
       to_char(s.expires_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS expires_at
FROM u CROSS JOIN t CROSS JOIN s;

-- Un email deja folosit de un cont cu parolă NU este preluat de Google (→ 409).
WITH u AS (
  INSERT INTO users (email, name, auth_provider)
  VALUES ($1, $2, 'google')
  ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, last_login_at = NOW()
    WHERE users.auth_provider = 'google'
  RETURNING id, email, name, auth_provider
),
t AS (SELECT encode(gen_random_bytes(32), 'hex') AS token),
s AS (
  INSERT INTO sessions (user_id, token_hash)
  SELECT u.id, encode(digest(t.token, 'sha256'), 'hex') FROM u CROSS JOIN t
  RETURNING expires_at
)
SELECT u.id::text AS id, u.email, u.name, u.auth_provider, t.token,
       to_char(s.expires_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS expires_at
FROM u CROSS JOIN t CROSS JOIN s;

-- Sesiune validă = token cunoscut, nerevocat, neexpirat (utilizatorul șters → sesiunile dispar prin CASCADE)
UPDATE sessions SET last_used_at = NOW()
WHERE token_hash = encode(digest($1, 'sha256'), 'hex')
  AND revoked_at IS NULL
  AND expires_at > NOW()
RETURNING user_id::text AS user_id;

SELECT a.id::text AS id, a.title, a.source, a.image_url, a.summary, a.article_url,
  a.read_time_minutes, a.category,
  to_char(a.published_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS published_at,
  a.full_content, a.ai_summary, a.ai_bullets, a.ai_tags, a.deep_dive,
  (bm.user_id IS NOT NULL) AS is_bookmarked
FROM articles a
LEFT JOIN bookmarks bm ON bm.article_id = a.id AND bm.user_id = $1::uuid
ORDER BY a.published_at DESC
LIMIT 500;

RETURNING user_id::text AS user_id;

SELECT a.id::text AS id, a.title, a.source, a.image_url, a.summary, a.article_url,
  a.read_time_minutes, a.category,
  to_char(a.published_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') AS published_at,
  a.full_content, a.ai_summary, a.ai_bullets, a.ai_tags, a.deep_dive,
  TRUE AS is_bookmarked
FROM bookmarks bm
JOIN articles a ON a.id = bm.article_id
WHERE bm.user_id = $1::uuid
ORDER BY bm.created_at DESC
LIMIT 300;
